parameters.query:
SELECT l.id, l.name, c.id AS city_id, c.name AS city_name
FROM ru_locations c
JOIN ru_locations l ON l.parent_id = c.id AND l.kind = 'city_district'
WHERE c.id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY l.name
LIMIT 9 OFFSET $2::int;

WITH u AS (
  INSERT INTO bot_users (telegram_id) VALUES ($1::bigint)
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_id) DO NOTHING
),
loc AS (
  SELECT l.id, l.name, p.name AS parent_name
  FROM ru_locations l LEFT JOIN ru_locations p ON p.id = l.parent_id
  WHERE l.id = $2::uuid
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO user_locations (telegram_id, location_id, is_primary)
  SELECT $1::bigint, loc.id,
         NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_locations WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint)
  FROM loc
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING location_id
)
SELECT loc.name, loc.parent_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS added FROM loc;

SELECT l.id, l.name AS city_name, l.kind, p.name AS parent_name
FROM user_locations ul
JOIN ru_locations l ON l.id = ul.location_id
LEFT JOIN ru_locations p ON p.id = l.parent_id
WHERE ul.telegram_id = $1::bigint
ORDER BY ul.is_primary DESC, l.name
LIMIT 6 OFFSET $2::int;

SELECT l.id, l.name, l.kind, l.name_prep, l.lat, l.lon,
       p.name AS parent_name, p.type_name AS parent_type,
       p.lat AS parent_lat, p.lon AS parent_lon,
       (l.parent_id = l.region_id) AS parent_is_region,
       r.name AS region_name, r.type_name AS region_type
FROM ru_locations l
LEFT JOIN ru_locations p ON p.id = l.parent_id
LEFT JOIN ru_locations r ON r.id = l.region_id
WHERE l.id = $1::uuid;

UPDATE ru_locations
SET lat = $2::float8, lon = $3::float8, coord_source = $4, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING lat, lon;

parameters.query:
SELECT l.id, l.name AS city_name, l.kind, p.name AS parent_name
FROM user_locations ul
JOIN ru_locations l ON l.id = ul.location_id
LEFT JOIN ru_locations p ON p.id = l.parent_id
WHERE ul.telegram_id = $1::bigint
ORDER BY l.name
LIMIT 6 OFFSET $2::int;

DELETE FROM user_locations
WHERE telegram_id = $1::bigint AND location_id = $2::uuid;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS act, $2::bigint AS tg, NULLIF($3, '')::uuid AS loc,
         NULLIF($4, '')::time AS t, NULLIF($5, '')::int AS nid, NULLIF($6, '') AS tz
),
u AS (
  INSERT INTO bot_users (telegram_id) SELECT tg FROM p ON CONFLICT (telegram_id) DO NOTHING
),
add_n AS (
  INSERT INTO notifications (telegram_id, location_id, notify_time)
  SELECT p.tg, p.loc, p.t FROM p
  WHERE p.act = 'add'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_locations ul WHERE ul.telegram_id = p.tg AND ul.location_id = p.loc)
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM notifications n WHERE n.telegram_id = p.tg AND n.location_id = p.loc) < 5
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
),
del_n AS (
  DELETE FROM notifications n USING p
  WHERE p.act = 'del' AND n.id = p.nid AND n.telegram_id = p.tg
  RETURNING 1
),
flip AS (
  UPDATE notifications n SET enabled = NOT n.enabled FROM p
  WHERE p.act = 'flip' AND n.id = p.nid AND n.telegram_id = p.tg
  RETURNING 1
),
tog AS (
  UPDATE notifications n
  SET enabled = NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications x WHERE x.telegram_id = p.tg AND x.enabled)
  FROM p
  WHERE p.act = 'toggle' AND n.telegram_id = p.tg
  RETURNING 1
),
tzs AS (
  UPDATE bot_users b SET timezone = p.tz FROM p
  WHERE p.act = 'tz' AND b.telegram_id = p.tg
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM add_n) AS added, (SELECT count(*) FROM del_n) AS deleted;

SELECT l.id, l.name AS city_name, l.kind, p.name AS parent_name,
       COALESCE(b.notify_on, true) AS notify_on,
       COALESCE(b.timezone, 'Europe/Moscow') AS tz,
       COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', n.id, 't', to_char(n.notify_time, 'HH24:MI'), 'on', n.enabled) ORDER BY n.notify_time)
                 FROM notifications n
                 WHERE n.telegram_id = ul.telegram_id AND n.location_id = ul.location_id), '[]'::json) AS times
FROM user_locations ul
JOIN ru_locations l ON l.id = ul.location_id
LEFT JOIN ru_locations p ON p.id = l.parent_id
LEFT JOIN bot_users b ON b.telegram_id = ul.telegram_id
WHERE ul.telegram_id = $1::bigint
ORDER BY ul.is_primary DESC, l.name
LIMIT 100;
